name: physics-xgb
condition_mechanism: implicit via dG(T, Na+): features recomputed at each row's own temperature and salt
split: probe-grouped, 20% of probes held out, seed 0
supersedes: L4 (104 features, width-BOUND) -- retired to models/retired/. physics-xgb IS L4t; nothing should reference L4 as shipping.
hyperparameters_chosen_by: held-out PR-AUC over 8 configurations; see results/physics_xgb_sweep.json
comparison_framing: two-point, old versus new. PaintSHOP-XGB is left EXACTLY as published (100 rounds, depth 10) and is not refitted. OM2 improves BOTH the features (L4t) and the training (this sweep), so the difference is NOT attributable to the encoder alone and must not be described as a controlled ablation.
threshold_note: binder convention from the NUPACK label (pDup >= 0.5), identical across all four cards; not a tuned operating point
